title: MAESTRO: Open-Ended Environment Design for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

layout.note: A top row runs Environment Generator, grey pair box, Evaluate, Student Agent, Train, light blue pair box. Below it a large framed region holds the dashed Co-Player Population over the Environment Buffers in four aligned columns, one colour each. Vertical dashed and solid arrows join the top row to the region.

lesson: Give each member of a population one colour and carry it onto its own memory: a robot icon above a tile of the same colour holding a stack of sample thumbnails. Run verb-labelled arrows between population, generator and learner, and colour the keywords in the labels to tie them to the boxes they name.
